propositions: Slow tests are currently invisible in CI until manually profiled, reducing visibility into performance regressions.
The --durations=25 flag should be added to default-suite pytest invocations in gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml to surface the 25 slowest tests in every gate run.
A post-merge step should optionally store per-test durations in .test_durations for cross-runner sharding with pytest-split.
The .test_durations file must be gitignored and artifact-only to prevent accidental commits and repo-leak violations.
